description:
Workflow for quality assessment and taxonomic classification of amplicon long read sequences. In addition files are exported to their respective subfolders for easier data management in a later stage. Input reads are exprected to be fastq files. Preferably Super accurate (sup) in case of Nanopore or PacBio HiFi **Steps**: - **Sequali** (quality assessment)
- **fastplong** (filtering)
- **Emu**: species-level taxonomic abundance for full-length 16S reads
- **savont**: ASV generation and taxonomic profiling for long read amplicons
name: Longread amplicon classifcation workflow
